KS Collection

Let every adavu shine a little brighter

Rich silks, gleaming zari borders and pleated fans that open like a flower with every araimandi. Our costumes catch the stage lights and move with the dancer, so each mudra, each jathi and each abhinaya is seen in its full grace.

From a first recital to the grand arangetram, dress your dancer in a costume worthy of the art. Sizes 24 to 42, for dancers from age 5 to adult.
